name: hcoll_v5_qso3n-qs1045-COMMIT
purpose: hard_v5 COLL q3 qslots 1-bit switch slice (NS11 ND16, bit 544), 1x in q3; every output a flop Q.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_coll_qso_q3_b1 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hfd_coll_q_hard_v5.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hgi_coll_qslots.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_qso3n/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_qso3n/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_qso3n --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_coll_qso_q3_b1  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Coordinator one-pass qso resize after the qso3w/qso2w FLOORPLAN_MARGIN verdicts (flow std = 1.27x gate synth): expected flow std ~142 um2 = 48% at 21.6x21.6, the lattice size nearest 55% (19.44 -> 62% > 60% cap), so the outline is kept; q3 bench peak_ram_gb 40 -> 128 (q3 lockstep with two KMAX-2048 TKMs SIGKILLed at 40 GB). Plus the recipe-2 output stage (io_flop_at_pins on outputs only, pin_reg_split, keep_pin_regs) so dst launch meets the native 220-ps budget (qcap twin failed launch 240.4 without it).
